title: Veracruz Tourism Intelligence
subtitle: Data-driven exploration of tourism destinations in Veracruz.
overview_text: This project combines tourism, economic and destination data to analyze tourism opportunities in Veracruz.
destinations_text: Explore tourism characteristics, destination similarities, official tourism products and national analogues.
methods_text: This section explains the datasets, analytical pipeline, clustering, forecasting and other methods used in the project.
